taskDescription: Verify complete Watchlist Configuration workflow can be executed using keyboard only

expectedResult: Focus moves in logical left-to-right and top-to-bottom order without skipping interactive elements

taskDescription: Verify keyboard focus remains within active modal dialog
expectedResult: Keyboard focus remains trapped inside modal until action is completed or cancelled

taskDescription: Verify buttons and actions expose accessible names
